text: FlowForge Ultimate Master Specification

Chapter 1: Vision
This chapter defines architecture standards, entities, schemas, endpoint patterns, workflow
requirements, permission requirements, integration contracts, tenant boundaries, validation rules,
audit controls, reporting requirements, testing expectations, operational controls and
implementation considerations. Representative entities include Tenant, User, Role, Permission,
AuditEvent, WorkflowInstance, Document, Connector, Customer, Vendor, Order, Invoice,
InventoryItem, Shipment, Employee, PayrollRun, Project, Asset, WorkOrder, CAPA and
MedicalRecord. Representative API patterns include CRUD, search, bulk operations, approval
actions, reporting actions and webhook subscriptions. Representative tests include unit, integration,
security, tenant isolation, audit verification, workflow validation, performance, recovery and
